hypotheses.name: Receding-Horizon GAN Consensus for DT
hypotheses.observed_failure: DT locally helps at 3k/H200 but decays by H1000 and becomes harmful at 4k
hypotheses.unsb_object: full optimizer-state transition under the native GAN component
hypotheses.derivation: From the same immutable full state S_k, compute B0=Phi_0^32(S_k) and Bi=Phi_dt^32(S_k). Let Delta=G_GAN(Bi)-G_GAN(B0). Commit Bi iff Delta<0; otherwise commit B0.
hypotheses.identity_condition: Delta_G_GAN >= 0 commits the exact plain branch
hypotheses.self_null_condition: a rejected proposal contributes zero parameters, moments, schedulers, streams or RNG state
hypotheses.paired_target_proof: the decision reads only branch-averaged unpaired G_GAN; PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS and confirmation identities are absent from the controller interface
hypotheses.expected_valid_states: states whose 32-step observable retains its audited lead relationship
hypotheses.falsification_test: proposal-only, observable-only/plain, and full selector from the same e0; kill if the selector chooses harmful H200 branches or fails the 2400-step late gate
hypotheses.compute_cost: two 32-update branches per committed 32 updates; proposal branch inherits parent-probe cost
hypotheses.memory_cost: one live branch at a time plus one CPU full-state snapshot
pseudocode: commit proposal if mean(G_GAN)_proposal < mean(G_GAN)_plain else plain

evidence.reason: the 32-update precursor does not divide the frozen 400-update evaluation interval; a separately audited 8-update signal is used

hypotheses.name: Future-Batch Gradient Consensus for DT
hypotheses.observed_failure: G1-DT-RHGC8 changed from +0.104052 dB at 400 to -0.381266 dB at 800 despite committing 3/100 proposal blocks
hypotheses.unsb_object: one-sided alignment of the proposal correction with the next-batch native UNSB generator gradient
hypotheses.derivation: Run B0=Phi_0^8(S) and Bi=Phi_i^8(S). Let delta be the G/F parameter correction theta_i-theta_0 and let g+ be the native UNSB generator gradient at B0 on the next independent unpaired batch. Commit Bi only when -1*(Delta G_GAN)>0 and <delta,g+><0.
hypotheses.identity_condition: failure of either the audited lead gate or future-gradient gate commits the exact plain full state
hypotheses.self_null_condition: rejected proposal and audit computations contribute no parameters, moments, scheduler, stream, RNG or method co-state
hypotheses.paired_target_proof: both gates read only unpaired training losses, G/F parameter displacement and a native gradient on the next unpaired batch
hypotheses.expected_valid_states: states where the historical short lead and an independent future native descent direction agree
hypotheses.falsification_test: from the same e0, kill after the 800-update micro run if final delta is non-positive or guardrails fail; no further revision is allowed
hypotheses.compute_cost: plain and proposal 8-update branches plus one native next-batch generator forward/backward per block
hypotheses.memory_cost: one live branch plus CPU full-state snapshots
pseudocode: commit proposal iff lead and consensus else exact plain

evidence.summary: identical to G1 DT at 400/800; final delta -0.381266
